info.flavor: For centuries, folktales on Maguayan have warned of pale spirits that roam the wilderness, cursing those who trespass on their territory with ill fortune. These stories, once dismissed by outsiders as the superstition of a backwater planet, have only grown more vivid and widespread with time. Theorists agree the mysterious entities must be paracausal in nature, but more specific conclusions require further data.
info.tactics: The Lantern is a highly mobile support that makes nearby enemies easier to attack and liable to taking additional damage. It can mark an individual character with a targetable shadow that effectively increases their hurtbox, denying them cover. Lanterns can close distance easily but pose little threat on their own; they work best with allies that can reliably output damage and keep them alive.
info.terse: Fast-flying support that makes nearby enemies easier to attack and damage.

actions.name: Shadow Tag
actions.detail:
Haunt a hostile character within Sensors. Until they end their turn outside your line of sight or Sensors, or you become Jammed or Stunned, the following effects apply:
  • The haunted character casts a Line 5 shadow along the ground. The shadow is as wide and tall as their Size, with its tip located as far away from you as possible, and it updates its direction at the end of each turn.
  • While you or any allied character takes a turn, you or they may treat the shadow as part of the haunted character for any purpose.
  • The haunted character treats you as Invisible, and you make all checks and saves against them with +1 Accuracy.
  • You cannot take this action again.

apply_special.detail:
You cast a Line 5 shadow along the ground. It is as wide and tall as your Size, with its tip located as far away from the Lantern as possible, and it updates its direction at the end of each turn.
While the Lantern or any allied character takes their turn, they may treat the shadow as part of you for any purpose.
You treat the Lantern as Invisible, and they make all checks and saves against you with +1 Accuracy.

name: Will-O-Wisp
effect: The Lantern may add +1 Accuracy to any attack against a character within Range 3. If the attack then results in a critical hit, the Lantern also deals {3/4/5} Burn to the target.

actions.name: Will-O-Wisp
actions.trigger: An attack is rolled against a character within Range 3.
actions.detail: You may add +1 Accuracy to the attack. If it results in a critical hit, you also deal {3/4/5} Burn to the target.

actions.name: Heat Wave
actions.detail:
This system can only be used while you are in the Danger Zone and before you move or take any non-protocol action on your turn.
Clear all Heat. Hostile characters within Burst 3 must pass an Agility save or take Heat equal to half the amount you cleared and become Shredded until the end of their next turn.

name: Levitate
effect: The Lantern can count any and all of its movement as flying. 1/round, when it would make a Hull check or save, it may roll with its Agility instead.

active_effects.name: Fly (Levitate)
active_effects.detail: You can count any and all of your movement as flying.

active_effects.name: Bounce (Levitate)
active_effects.condition: You would make a Hull check or save.
active_effects.detail: You may roll with your Agility instead of your Hull.

actions.name: Glare
actions.detail: Until the start of your next turn, whenever a ranged or melee attack targets you or any allied character within Range 3, first roll 1d6. If the result is not higher than half your Heat and your are not Exposed or Stunned, the attack automatically misses. This effect does not stack with Invisible.

add_special.detail: Whenever a ranged or melee attack targets you or any allied character within Range 3, first roll 1d6. If the result is not higher than half your Heat and you are not Exposed or Stunned, the attack automatically misses. This effect does not stack with Invisible.

name: Illuminate
effect: When the Lantern uses Will-O-Wisp on an attack, it may remove all Difficulty from the final roll.

actions.name: Confuse Ray
actions.detail: Make a tech attack against a character within Sensors. On a hit, until the end of their next turn, they cannot draw line of sight into or out of the Burst 3 area around you, and cannot be affected by any other character hostile to you unless they have line of sight to that character. You cannot take this action again until its effects end.

add_special.detail: You cannot draw line of sight into or out of the Burst 3 area around the Lantern, and cannot be affected by any other character hostile to the Lantern unless you have line of sight to that character.

actions.name: Mystical Fire
actions.detail: Hostile characters within Burst 3 must pass an Agility save or take {3/4/5} Burn. Until the end of your next turn, hostile characters within Burst 3 cannot clear Burn and you cannot take this action again.

add_special.detail: Hostile characters within Burst 3 cannot clear Burn.

actions.name: Nightmare
actions.detail: Until the end of the round, allied characters always have line of sight to characters within Burst 3 of you and ignore cover, Invisible, and Hidden when targeting them. This action cannot be taken if it was already used in this round or the previous one.

name: Night Shade [Veteran]
effect: Hostile characters may not enter or draw line of sight into or through spaces within, above, or below the shadow of the character haunted by Shadow Tag.
